findings.subject: VAR-childmth
findings.title: `VAR-childmth` reads prelude `MOD-DEM-childmth_clean`: Preludes should not invent sentinel values unless the downstream binding explicitly maps them. This code encodes mth>59 as -1.0 (comment: 'sentinel for invalid values within universe') but the prelude itself provides no report/additional flag and nothing here guarantees the binding will treat -1 as missing reason .b rather than as a real month value. Prefer emitting NaN plus a separate derived flag, or ensure the binding/missing_map routes -1 -> .b. Also, it relies on age>=5 producing NaN to be routed to .c, which only holds if the binding’s missing_map is configured that way.

Also, it relies on age>=5 producing NaN to be routed to .c, which only holds if the binding’s missing_map is configured that way.
